text.headline: AI agents that work together to run a smarter telco
text.idea: I am learning Gen AI, AI agents and Agentic AI by building them for real telecom problems. This page shows what a telco AI portfolio can look like: connected AI agents that help Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Revenue Assurance and Operations make better decisions. The agents come from my telecom transformation case study.
text.footer: Prototypes for learning and demonstration. Synthetic or public data only; nothing connects to a real operator's systems.
text.statusNote: Solid border = being built or live. Dashed = planned or later. Dotted = design only.

sections.title: The big picture: AI agents working for each telco team
sections.lede: Each telco team gets its own AI agents. A Master AI Agent passes work between them through shared data, and a person approves anything that affects a customer. Together they serve four business goals.

human.name: Human approval
human.note: a person approves any customer action

agents.name: Master AI Agent
agents.purpose: The controller and connector of all the agents. Each agent can work on its own, and through the Master AI Agent they also work together, with people and with ticketing tools such as Jira. It reads events from the shared log, decides which agent or person acts next, and sends any action that affects a customer to a person for approval first.
agents.input: Events from all agents, people and tickets
agents.output: Which agent or person acts next

agents.name: AI Hyper-personalisation Agent
agents.brain: Rules + value calculation + LLM, human approval
agents.purpose: Picks the right remedy or offer for each customer and checks it is worth more than it costs. Live: for a confirmed double charge it proposes the refund plus a 5GB roaming bonus for a frequent traveller, explains why, drafts the message, and a supervisor approves it.
agents.output: Remedy, its value, and a message for approval

agents.name: AI Churn Prediction Agent
agents.purpose: Predicts which customers may leave and why, so Marketing can target retention offers.

agents.name: GenAI Customer Service Agent
agents.tagline: chat agent for customer queries, bills first
agents.purpose: A chat agent that works out what the customer needs (bill issue, recharge, internet or WiFi) and answers in plain English using only their bill, payments and the tariff, quoting the lines it used. Bill issues are live: it spots a double charge, logs a ticket and hands the case to the Master AI Agent.

agents.name: Revenue Assurance Agent
agents.purpose: Compares what each customer used with what they were billed, flags mismatches and writes a short note for an analyst.

agents.name: Fraud Agent
agents.purpose: Flags suspicious calling patterns, such as SIM-box signs or unusual international calls, and prepares a case for an investigator.

agents.name: AI Bill Check Agent
agents.purpose: When a customer disputes a bill, it checks each bill line against usage, tariff and order history and explains what is wrong. Until it is built, a person on the billing team does this step through a Jira ticket.
agents.input: Disputed bill + usage, tariff and order history
agents.output: Bill check result with the wrong lines

agents.name: Order Automation Agent
agents.purpose: Finds stuck or failed orders and suggests the fix.

agents.name: AIOps Network Assurance Agent
agents.purpose: Predicts network faults from alarms and performance data (design stage).

story.title: The customer reports a high bill
story.text: A premium postpaid customer (customer 1042) tells the GenAI Customer Service Agent that this month's bill is $87 instead of the usual $62. The agent logs a complaint and asks the Master AI Agent to find out why.

story.title: The Master AI Agent checks the order
story.text: It asks the Order Automation Agent whether the order was set up wrongly (incorrect order orchestration). The order history looks correct, so the problem must be in the bill itself.

story.title: A person checks the bill, for now
story.text: The AI Bill Check Agent is planned for this step. Until it is built, the Master AI Agent escalates to the billing team with a Jira ticket holding all the details. The team finds a roaming pack charged twice ($25).

story.title: The Master AI Agent asks for a remedy
story.text: With the error confirmed, it sends the case to the AI Hyper-personalisation Agent, together with the customer's past usage and value.

story.title: A remedy that fits the customer
story.text: This is a premium customer who roams often, so it proposes a $25 refund plus a 5 GB roaming bonus as an apology.

story.title: A person approves
story.text: A supervisor approves and the refund goes for processing. The action is simulated, so nothing real is sent.
